summary.text: Brienne Brown is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 43 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her current term as beginning on January 6, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Brienne Brown served on the Whitewater Common Council for three terms, according to Ballotpedia.

She has also served on the Equal Opportunities Commission and Board of Appeals, the Forestry Commission, the parks and recreation board and the library board, and has volunteered with the Whitewater Community Foundation and the Whitewater Grocery Cooperative.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Brown described herself as the child of Vietnam veterans and said she had worked as an investigative journalist, in public health and as a small business owner, and that she taught at UW-Whitewater.
Her key campaign messages in that survey were funding public education at the promised two-thirds level, making health care affordable and accessible, and gun regulation.
Brown was assigned to the Agriculture Committee and the Veterans and Military Affairs Committee for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
